prior_unfrozen_probe.disclosure: An earlier run of this job was executed WITHOUT a frozen protocol, during a push to parallelise. #1234 requires the freeze before protected outcome access, so that run is NOT admissible as evidence and its terminal is not claimed. It is recorded as an unfrozen exploratory probe.
prior_unfrozen_probe.consequence: This protocol governs a DIFFERENT and larger grid whose outcomes have not been accessed. Re-freezing the same grid after seeing its results would be post-hoc dressed as procedure.
prior_unfrozen_probe.what_the_probe_exposed: The unfrozen probe's key-compromise arm was TAUTOLOGICAL. It looped over a hardcoded compromised flag and incremented false_promotions when compromised was true, so it reported 0/6 detection by construction rather than by test. That number matched P15's paper finding, which is exactly why it was dangerous: a constructed result agreeing with a real one is indistinguishable from confirmation. The arm is replaced with an enumeration over adversary capabilities in which detection is COMPUTED from what the signature layer can observe.
prior_unfrozen_probe.grid_change: State space widened to 5x4x4, and the key-compromise arm REPLACED with a real adversary enumeration rather than a hardcoded outcome.

information_and_tool_access.runner: declared grid only; no network, no model calls

multiplicity: No hypothesis test; universal and existence claims over total enumeration.
constitutional_note: May confirm, refute or narrow an instantiation. May not redesign a theorem, move a gate, weaken a comparator, hide a negative, or rewrite theory after outcome access.
task: Production host/process fault injection, production attestation comparator, custody compromise, overhead.

estimands.T20_noninterference: Over every execution-only transformation (f, id, id) and every state: are validity and authority unchanged, with zero exceptions?
estimands.bridge_is_explicit: Does every V or A update require a bridge premise, i.e. never occur under an execution-only transformation?
estimands.key_compromise_computed: Over an enumeration of adversary capabilities: is detection by the signature layer COMPUTED from observable facts, and does the signature layer fail to detect custody compromise because custody is not among them?

positive_conditions: zero V/A updates without a bridge premise
the key-compromise arm computes detection from observables rather than asserting it
both detected and undetected adversary cases occur
negative_conditions: any execution-only transformation altering V or A
any V/A update without a bridge premise
the key-compromise arm cannot produce a detected case, which would mean detection is impossible by construction rather than by custody being unobservable
independent_unit: The declared grid cell; points within a cell are exhaustively enumerated, not sampled.

checker_and_authority_owner.independence_boundary: Two implementations inside one programme; not external adjudication.
